subject: session date
fact: The session occurs on the 5th day of the 2nd Tenday of Taraskh 1493 DR.
source_quote: The party found themselves in Diggermattock Hall, where Chief Dorbo and Senni engaged in a heated discussion about the future of Blingdenstone.

subject: elapsed time
fact: An hour passes between two events in the session.
source_quote: Almost immediately, another ghost appeared—Borough Warden Jadger...

subject: chasme count
fact: Four chasme demons are present in the cavern above the prisoners' tower.

subject: travel to Sloobludop
fact: Sloobludop is approximately eight days away via the Darklake.
source_quote: the town of Sloopdopblop is just eight days away

subject: Velkynvelve elevation
fact: Velkynvelve sits 100 feet above the cavern floor.
source_quote: Drow outpost was 100' in the sky

subject: silver candlestick value
fact: The silver candlesticks flanking the Lolth altar are worth 25 gp each.
source_quote: a pair of heavy silver candlesticks worth 25 gp each

subject: Pelek's burial ritual
fact: Grygum performed a dragon-themed ritual and planted a gold coin as a symbolic foundation.
source_quote: Grygum found a quiet corner and carefully interred Pelek's bones, performing a dragon-themed ritual and planting a gold coin as a symbolic foundation.

subject: Pelek's spirit materialization
fact: Pelek's ghost materialized before Glyphic Shroomlight, prompting him to reconsider interring the bones.
source_quote: when Pelek's ghost materialized before him, Glyphic quickly reconsidered...

subject: catacombs location
fact: The catacombs lie below the Temple of the Ruby in the Rough, dedicated to Segojan Earthcaller.
source_quote: A guard directed them to the cemetery adjacent to the Temple of the Ruby in the Rough, dedicated to Segojan Earthcaller...

subject: Glabbagool's identity
fact: Glabbagool is an intelligent gelatinous cube companion who remains upstairs to avoid accidents.
source_quote: asking only that Glabbagool, their intelligent gelatinous cube companion, remain upstairs to avoid any accidents.

subject: Jadger's offer
fact: For every ghost they helped put to rest, Jadger would answer one question about the Underdark and its dangers.
source_quote: for every ghost they helped put to rest, he would answer one question about the Underdark and its dangers.

subject: Jadger's clarification on devils and demons
fact: Devils corrupt individuals through personal deals, while demons empower proxies to cause widespread carnage and destruction.
source_quote: he explained the difference between devils and demons: devils corrupt individuals through personal deals, while demons empower proxies to cause widespread carnage and destruction.

subject: Trader's Grotto location
fact: The Trader's Grotto is Blingdenstone's bustling central market, built atop petrified fungi.
source_quote: The party made their way to the Trader's Grotto, Blingdenstone's bustling central market... fungi had once grown there until a medusa's spell turned them to stone centuries ago.

subject: non-sentient gelatinous cubes
fact: Several non-sentient gelatinous cubes oozed out of the rocks, causing mass panic among merchants.
source_quote: Suddenly, several non-sentient gelatinous cubes oozed out of the rocks, causing mass panic among the merchants.

subject: Zalthir's eldritch claw activation
fact: Zalthir activated his eldritch claw tattoo, growing tentacles from his hands to strike from a distance.
source_quote: Zalthir activated his eldritch claw tattoo, growing tentacles from his hands that allowed him to strike from a distance...

subject: Grygum's necrotic blast
fact: Grygum channeled divine energy through his holy symbol, blasting one of the cubes with searing necrotic force.
source_quote: Grygum channeled divine energy through his holy symbol, blasting one of the cubes with searing necrotic force.

subject: Daz's fiery explosion
fact: Daz unleashed a massive explosion of fire, dissolving one cube entirely and severely damaging the others.
source_quote: Daz carefully positioned himself and unleashed a massive explosion of fire, dissolving one cube entirely and severely damaging the others...

subject: final cube defeated
fact: Zalthir delivered the killing blow to the last remaining cube, reduced to a single hit point.
source_quote: only one cube remained, reduced to a single hit point, and Zalthir delivered the killing blow.

subject: Thorin's complaint
fact: Thorin complained that he wanted to do it.
source_quote: Thorin complained that he wanted to do it.
